scope: Read-only recovery of the census contract, repository history, existing source and saved output. No corpus processing, model inference, training, uploading, resource mutation or checkout changes.

root.head: c7a9e8d6725a110f6bd3b299acbb3ab434870fce
root.scope: This survey did not fetch or verify root remote; parent owns current main integration.

reusable_files.role: Pinned local sole-writer census with transactional occurrence/count/cursor commits, restart and exact disposition reports.
Historical 64-valid-document ordinal replay; include_candidates=True preserves unlisted and mismatched occurrences. Matched-only default remains compatible.
Source-only census CLI; no model, download, training or existing live catalog.
Existing controls for historical boundaries, restart, atomic rollback, conflicts, explicit lengths, optional local tokenizer, exclusive writer and foreign database refusal.
Budget and complete normalized historical sentence extraction contract.
Clone a stopped WAL-free manifest/database into a fresh result directory and resume without mutating old findings.
Fresh named attempt, existing resource owner and scheduler adoption, sampled usage, child PID/birth ownership, lease watchdog, deadline and durable finalization.

existing_constraints: Resume matches exact source/progress paths, revisions, hashes, extraction code hashes, tokenizer and section/span/byte bounds. Runtime section_batch_size, memory, output storage and max_batches are not generation identity fields.

The saved generation has no tokenizer. Adding genuine 384D or 768D producer token counts creates a separate pinned generation or separately keyed measurement, rather than changing its existing manifest.

Complete-source text reconstruction differs from the present historical whitespace-normalized sentence extraction. The pinned original section bytes remain available, but the census does not preserve original sentence byte offsets or decoder text outputs.
Every regenerated occurrence is persisted, including unlisted occurrences. Current census is not limited to the archived 443,904 sealed/gap export.
Historical original counters conditionally imply 3,842,642 underlying inventory rows; this is not an authenticated denominator or measured full fit.

A single section exceeding max_section_bytes=8388608, max_batch_spans=8192 or max_batch_bytes=33554432 is refused without advancing its cursor. One-section batches fix multi-section overflow but do not solve single-section overflow.
The 128 MiB output default checks after transactions and exports; resource enforcement is cooperative/polled and is not a kernel quota.
The old operator wrapper hardcodes the October 7 package root and helpers. Reuse it only after the parent independently authenticates helper/code/resource binding and creates a fresh owned attempt.
Original compiled, mock 8D and sealed observations never become learned reconstruction, model eligibility, training qualification or proof success.

immediate_existing_path: Authenticate current resource accounting and shared scheduler state without releasing foreign claims; parent owns those actions.
Rehash the two existing immutable local inputs and verify saved manifest/database state and absence of an unreconciled WAL.
Clone the saved manifest and database into a fresh owned attempt; reuse exact code hashes and source/text bounds.
Resume with section_batch_size=1 and an explicitly bounded window, such as max_batches=64, under one CPU slot and observed process-group memory/storage/deadline bounds.
Independently replay the new committed prefix; report actual matched/unlisted counts, original offsets, non-skipped ordinals, maximum observed memory/storage and explicit stop reasons.
next_implementation_if_scaling_beyond_bo: Implement a separately versioned immutable source-occurrence shard sink with content hashes, physical section ranges and transactional controller manifest/cursor updates. Keep archive join aliases and aggregate counts in one controller; do not silently discard unlisted source identities.

If the campaign deliberately selects an archived-target scope instead, declare a distinct generation and retain full-source accounting/dispositions separately. Do not describe an archived-target scan as a complete source inventory.
Provide explicit pending/overflow dispositions or a reviewed section/span streaming interface for a section that cannot fit current bounds, preserving the historical extraction and ordinal contract.
Measure output bytes per occurrence and runtime across varied sections before selecting a full-run reservation. Existing first 128 sections do not establish a fit for all sources.

After census scale controls, reconcile paired/modal bodies against canonical occurrences, then route only compatible authenticated native caches/checkpoints by IR family, dimension, schema/version, decoder task and producer context.
avoid: Do not retrain models or replace existing assets to complete census.
Do not rehash archived IDs using current per-document ordinals.
Do not call all unlisted observations new text, duplicates, missing work or drift without further source/generation evidence.
Do not lower model quality or proof gates merely to treat the archived sealed flag as complete.
